sentences.text: On June 1, 2026, Fernwhistle County EMS documented a cyclist struck by a car at low speed, left shoulder pain, and transport to Thornapple Valley Hospital ED.
On June 1, 2026, Thornapple Valley Hospital ED documented a diagnosis of left clavicle fracture, provided a sling, and referred the patient to orthopedics, Dr. Mortimer Tallowby.
On June 9, 2026, Wombleton Orthopedics, Dr. Tallowby, documented a left clavicle fracture with nonoperative management and a sling for 4 more weeks.
On June 23, 2026, Crumpet Lane Orthopedics, M. Tallowby, MD, documented that callus formation was noted and that the sling was to continue.
On July 14, 2026, Wombleton Orthopedics, Dr. Tallowby, documented clinical union and release to light duty.
